questions.subject: HUMAN_GEOGRAPHY
questions.topic: Distance at which two bid-rent curves meet
questions.stem: In a study group, two land uses' bid-rent curves intersect at a distance from the center. What does this point represent?

options.text: The point of maximum rent for both uses.
The city center itself.
The boundary where one land use outbids the other.
A location where neither use is viable.

questions.explanation: The intersection of two bid-rent curves is where one land use's willingness to pay equals the other's, marking the boundary between their zones. It is not the center, a peak, or a nonviable site.
